findings.title: The walk's folder-listing refusal reaches default behaviour and is stated in no spec

walk_entry.title: Account-folder read failures silently remove the account from the reading

findings.recommendation: The X2 repair makes selectUnreadRecords fail on an unlistable decisions/ folder under every sign-off setting, so on that error path a default install now refuses an in-context system review emit and the archive emit (after the move) where it read the folder as empty. G0 says a default install behaves exactly as today except the named exceptions, and the walk's ledger entry records no G0 reasoning. Nor does any artifact carry the behaviour: orbit-emit-composition's refusal table for an in-context system payload has no unlistable-folder row, its archive row says the field is a count, and orbit-decision-records' whole-or-absent paragraph and docs/cli.md's decisions-brief paragraph do not name a folder that cannot be listed. Recommend A: narrow both listing checks to signoff: change, so the default path is byte-for-byte as before, and state the refusal in the delta specs and docs/cli.md for that value.

recommendation_options.label: A
recommendation_options.body: Run the listing checks only when the sign-off setting is change (both folders), leaving every other value as before; add the refusal to orbit-emit-composition's delta (an unlistable-folder row in the in-context refusal table and on the archive count), to orbit-decision-records' whole-or-absent paragraph, and to docs/cli.md's decisions-brief paragraph; move the decisions/ test under change and add a default-value test that reads an unlistable decisions/ folder as before.

recommendation_options.label: B
recommendation_options.body: Keep the checks under every value, state them in the same specs and docs, and take G0 to the architect session as a question (a ruling amendment: an error path that now fails loudly by default), recording a stop before asking.

commentary: Verified the two system walks against the tree at their commit. Six of the seven repairs hold as claimed: the archive narrative in concepts.md and commands.md now matches the hold's table, the two docs claims are narrowed, the account.ts header is true, --hold without --change is refused by name, and the hold's stored-record check now matches the write gate, each new refusal shown able to fail. The seventh, the folder-listing check, is right in what it does under signoff: change, but it reaches the default path too and was carried into no spec; the reader of this pass's decision records flagged the same G0 gap from the ledger side. The residual diff since the external return holds no file outside the walks' edit records. The reading read 21 records, mostly from the exploration; its findings are rewordings, the one warning a sentence that could be read as the archive halting after a signature.
